review.why: Turns social videos, transcripts and creator research into posts, threads, scripts, newsletters and calendars, via extracted content atoms.
review.summary: Six steps: gather source URLs or transcripts, extract content atoms (hooks, stories, claims, frameworks, data, CTAs), pick output formats, rewrite for the user's voice, keep attribution notes and deliver drafts with variants. A markdown output layout lists sources, an atoms table and sections per format. Three pitfalls: plagiarism, one format for all platforms, losing the best hook.
strengths: Content atoms table links each idea to its source and best format
Keeps attribution notes when ideas are inspired by a source
cautions: Very short: no per-platform rules and no examples
Assumes sibling skills from the same collection for transcripts and outlier posts
Declares a vendor API key requirement without saying where it is used
